figurative_meaning_bn: পথে কিছু দূর পর্যন্ত সঙ্গে যাওয়া
figurative_meaning_en: To accompany someone on their path for a short distance
example_sentences_in_bangla: অতিথিকে গেট পর্যন্ত এগিয়ে দিয়ে ফিরে এলাম।
example_sentences_in_english: I saw my friend off to the station.
I accompanied the guest to the gate before returning.
note: This idiom reflects Bengali hospitality and politeness in everyday farewells.
